meta.description: Registry for bounded orientation-sensitivity representation and conditions in Phase 3.

orientation_sensitivity_entries.name: Orientation Sensitivity Representation
orientation_sensitivity_entries.purpose: Represent bounded orientation-sensitive continuation behavior across recursive admissibility structures.

orientation_conditions.name: local_orientation_reference_defined
orientation_conditions.description: A bounded local frame of reference must be established for directional sensitivity analysis.

orientation_conditions.name: orientation_drift_remains_bounded
orientation_conditions.description: Cumulative deviation from the reference frame must stay within defined stability thresholds.

orientation_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_selection_permitted
orientation_conditions.description: Delta selection rules may incorporate local directional bias without forcing unique resolution.

orientation_conditions.name: orientation_transport_coupling_remains_finite
orientation_conditions.description: The influence of frame orientation on transport flux must remain within bounded limits.

orientation_conditions.name: orientation_bias_does_not_force_unique_continuation
orientation_conditions.description: Orientation-based metrics do not bypass the multi-valued nature of process actualization.

orientation_conditions.name: recursive_orientation_updates_remain_admissible
orientation_conditions.description: Each step in the recursive orientation update sequence must satisfy current admissibility windows.

orientation_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_orientation_witness
orientation_conditions.description: Pruning of divergent orientation branches must not eliminate all admissible directional candidates.

orientation_conditions.name: orientation_frame_instability_detectable
orientation_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register frame collapse or runaway drift.
